perf_budget_class_justification: PR #17 adds 173 pure-data files (JSON/JSONL evidence artifacts) under evidence/debate/. These files are written once and read only for audit queries — never on any compile, test, or runtime hot path. No Rust crate, no benchmark harness, no application binary is modified.
verdict_summary: No performance concern. PR #17 is 173 pure-data files (7,639 lines, ~448 KB text). git-pack compression reduces actual repo size delta to ~112 KB. At 100-PR scale, evidence accumulation reaches ~1.2 MB packed — negligible. No hot path (compile, test, runtime) is touched. Per-PR overhead of ~19 evidence files is proportionate to the 9-facet review doctrine and does not trigger any repo-size or CI-latency budget concern.

findings.summary: Repo size delta is ~112 KB packed for this PR; linear growth at 100 PRs projects to ~1.2 MB
findings.detail: 173 files, 7,639 lines, avg 44 lines/file. Text content ~448 KB. JSON compresses ~4:1 under git-pack, yielding ~112 KB actual object store growth. At steady-state (100 reviewed PRs, ~19 evidence files each), total evidence/ growth is ~1,900 files / ~1.2 MB packed. Well within any reasonable git repo size budget. No concern.

findings.summary: Per-PR overhead of ~19 files is proportionate; no evidence of file-count creep beyond doctrine
findings.detail: 9 PRs reviewed; 173 files / 9 = 19.2 files/PR. This matches the expected 9-facet x2-round structure (18 facet files + 1 synthesis). One PR (pr-5) has an extra r3 round due to F5 re-dispatch, explaining the slight overage. No unexpected file proliferation detected.

hot_path_impact.ci_latency_path: NONE — evidence/ is not scanned by any gate identified in gate/mod.rs or gate CLI

repo_size_assessment.detail: JSON is highly compressible. Repeated field names (change_id, facet_id, severity, etc.) across 173 files yield excellent pack ratios. No binary blobs, no generated images, no lock-file churn.

confidence_note: High confidence. Content is pure-data JSON/JSONL with no runtime coupling. Size estimates use conservative 4:1 git-pack ratio for JSON; actual savings may be higher due to cross-file dictionary compression in pack v2.
